ask: Is it right to fix the night test, not the app, so it waits for the server's fresh copy?
problem: The night test for removing a version failed once. The removed version still showed as Version 1 on the passage.
found: By design, a phone that already holds a version in its saved copy keeps showing it after removal. It waits until the server writes a newer saved copy. The test never waited for that. Other removal tests do wait. Whether it passes depends on when the server last wrote a copy. Pull request 394 does not touch this.
changed: Nothing changes for people. The test now waits until the removal is uploaded, then asks the server for a fresh saved copy, as the note removal test does.
why: A moderator's own phone shows a removed version for a while until the new copy exists. That is a recorded choice, so I kept it. I could not run the test here, as it needs Docker. The nightly run will confirm.
touches: Only the test file for moderation.

pictures.label: Failed run: the passage still shows Version 1 after removal

linear.comment: Cause: the test did not wait for the server's fresh saved copy after removal, so a phone with the version in its saved copy kept showing it. Test now waits for it. Not fixed by PR 394. See the draft pull request.
